legacy_claim: Numerical identities validate the theory implementation.
replacement_claim: Property tests verify the implementation of the stated formulas.
rationale: Software verification is retained but is not empirical VLM evidence.

legacy_claim: The selection law must use interventional do-compensability.
replacement_claim: Natural conditional success c_sel is the exact trajectory-selection input.
rationale: c_fork diagnoses whether natural selection is causally attributable to the mediator.

legacy_claim: Synthetic c[e] is evidence for natural VLM error selection.
replacement_claim: Treat exact KL with synthetic c[e] as a synthetic mechanism oracle only.
rationale: Artificial states require transport validation against natural mediator states.

legacy_claim: A single 16x16 PIL-CNN establishes the VLM mechanism.
replacement_claim: The single-scene result is a modular proof-of-mechanism only.
rationale: It lacks broad semantics, natural mediator replay, and real VLM training.

legacy_claim: Perception and reasoning errors add in a common Euclidean space.
replacement_claim: Use crossed risks D_P, D_R, and Gamma; retain additivity only as a special case.
rationale: Real VLM states are high-dimensional and no unique Euclidean split is identified.

legacy_claim: Black-box behavior identifies a unique perception/reasoning boundary.
replacement_claim: Report an operational certificate over a pre-registered interface family.
rationale: End-to-end factorization is non-identifiable from final behavior alone.

legacy_claim: The controlled mechanism has already been verified in a real VLM.
replacement_claim: Run the registered natural-mediator VLM regimes after the authenticated GPU gate.
rationale: Current CPU evidence stops before model download and large-GPU training.
